description: Configuration Wizard - Interactive configuration initialization with project detection
steps: Create lib/wizards/project-detector.js for automatic project type detection
Create lib/wizards/config-generator.js for generating configuration files
Create lib/ui/init-wizard-ui.js for Ink-based interactive wizard
Add 'init' command to bin/cli.js with --force and --minimal options
Support detection of Node.js, TypeScript, Python, React, Monorepo projects
acceptance_criteria: ctxman init command starts the configuration wizard
Project type is auto-detected (Node.js, TypeScript, Python, React, Monorepo)
Integration with existing ctxman wizard mode
verification: Run npm test and confirm all tests pass
Verify project detection for different project types
findings: Successfully implemented Configuration Wizard (FEAT-001). Created lib/wizards/project-detector.js with support for detecting Node.js, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Python, Rust, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP, .NET, and Monorepo projects. Created lib/wizards/config-generator.js for generating config files. Created lib/ui/init-wizard-ui.js for Ink-based interactive UI. Added 'ctxman init' command with --force, --minimal, and --yes flags. The wizard detects project types, shows recommended patterns, and generates .contextignore, .contextinclude files. All 990 tests pass.
